messages:
maria: quick q — during a support debug we pulled a temp dump that contains a customer's payment info (last4 + exp). it's sitting in the ephemeral cache directory used for troubleshooting. do we need a formal data-erase approval to scrub that, or can SRE just purge the cache? @jordan ?
jordan: TL;DR: purge is fine for last4/exp. full PANs (primary account numbers) are not allowed in logs and must be treated as a PII incident. for last4/exp we still want it removed ASAP and an RCA to prevent re-logging. steps: 1) confirm it's only last4/exp (not full PAN). 2) create internal ticket with keys/paths. 3) SRE will run a targeted purge + confirm. 4) security will mark the ticket closed after verification. also, push a fix so future dumps redact card fields. see policy: https://internal/docs/security/PII-data-policy-v3 (sec section).
lee: I can purge. we have a short-lived cache at tmp/support/<run-id> so targetting that prefix is safe. no org-level approval required if it's last4 only. please include the exact cache prefix and sample key in the ticket. I'll run:
```
./infra/tools/cache-purge --env=prod --prefix=tmp/support/2026-03-15-<run-id> --confirm
```
and post the job id here. expect ~30s.
sam: small note on traces: some spans occasionally carry metadata like `card.last4`. we have an auto-redact pipeline but it only runs on ingestion. if the debug dump was created before ingestion redaction we should check trace retention too. if traces contain last4 it's OK to purge but if full PAN appears we escalate to legal. pinging @eng-infra to double-check trace TTL and manual prune options.
jordan: to be explicit: do NOT post the raw value in public channels. use `xxxx` or `last4=****`. include only the cache keys in the ticket. add the customer id and support case id. security will verify the purge output and mark compliance note.
maria: filing ticket now in infra-requests with the prefix + one redacted sample. will link it here once submitted. thanks — will also add a quick PR to strip payment fields from the debug dumper.
deploy-bot: cache-purge job queued (job-id: 98765). will update on completion. :gear:
lee: purge completed. job 98765 removed 18 keys under prefix tmp/support/2026-03-15-<run-id>. created ticket INFRA-4123 and attached logs.
jordan: verified artifact review, no full PANs found, last4 confirmed present then removed. security note added to INFRA-4123. recommend follow-up: change dumper to `--redact-payment` default on prod.
maria: awesome, closing loop. filing the dumper PR now and adding a small test for redaction. thanks all :heart:
